seo.meta_description: Fundwright pricing: Free forever, Pro at ₹8,600 a year, Agency at ₹25,000 a year. Offline grant proposal software for NGOs, consultants and agencies in India. Runs on macOS and Windows with no internet and no cloud account.

seo.summary: Fundwright is desktop grant proposal software for NGOs, freelance proposal writers and multi-NGO agencies. It runs entirely offline on macOS and Windows: proposals, budgets, quotations, branding, document storage and AI rewriting all happen on the user's own laptop, with data kept in a local SQLite file. Three plans are sold: Free at ₹0 with 5 proposals a quarter, Pro at ₹8,600 a year for one user with unlimited proposals and offline AI enhancement, and Agency at ₹25,000 a year with four user roles, unlimited organisations and white labelling.

licence.title: No account. Just a file.
licence.intro: Fundwright has no sign-in screen. You buy once, receive a licence file, and drop it into the app. That is the whole activation.

steps.title: Pay online
steps.note: Card, UPI or bank transfer. GST invoice emailed with the receipt.

steps.title: Get licence.lic by email
steps.note: Usually within a few minutes. Save it somewhere you will find it again.

steps.title: Load it in the app
steps.note: Settings › Licence › Load file. Pro or Agency unlocks straight away, offline.

steps.title: Renew once a year
steps.note: A fresh licence file replaces the old one. Nothing else changes.

faq.q: What happens when my licence expires?
a: The app keeps working. It drops back to Free limits, so you go back to five proposals a quarter and watermarked PDF export.
Nothing is deleted. Every proposal, budget, template and stored document stays in your local database exactly as it was. Load a new licence file and all of it unlocks again on the same install.

faq.q: Can I move to a new laptop?
a: Yes. The licence follows you, not the machine. Install Fundwright on the new laptop and load the same licence.lic file.
To carry your work across, use Backup / restore on Pro and Agency, or copy the local database file directly on Free. If the old machine is gone for good, email us and we will re-issue the licence.

faq.q: Do I need internet to use Fundwright?
a: Only to buy and to receive the licence file. After that, no.

Writing, the Cost and Timeline estimators, exports, and the AI Proposal Enhancement all run on your own machine. The Qwen 2.5 model ships inside the installer, so rewriting and tone changes work on a train, in a field office, or on a village connection that comes and goes.

faq.q: How do I get my licence.lic file?
a: It is emailed to the address you paid with, usually within a few minutes of the payment clearing. Open Fundwright, go to Settings › Licence › Load file, and pick it.
Lost the email? Write to us from the same address and we will send it again at no cost.
Try everything on Free first, on the same installer the paid tiers use, so you know what you are buying before you pay.
If a paid licence will not activate and we cannot fix it, write to us within 7 days of purchase and we will refund in full. Renewals are refundable within 7 days if the renewal was accidental.

faq.q: Can two people share one Pro licence?
a: No. Pro is a single Owner seat with no user management. If two or more people need to work on the same proposals, Agency is the plan: four users, unlimited organisations, and shared budget templates.

faq_footer: Something not covered here? Write to us and we will answer within one working day.
